actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own New Relic action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your New Relic connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: search_metrics_data
actions.title: Search metrics data
actions.description: Search metrics data in New Relic

input.name: application_id
input.label: Application ID
input.hint: Can be found in the url of Application page

input.name: from
input.label: From
input.hint: To retrieve metrics after this time

input.name: to
input.label: To
input.hint: To retrieve metrics before this time

input.name: summarize
input.label: Summarize
input.hint: True for summarize the data over the time range

input.name: raw
input.label: Raw
input.hint: True to Return unformatted raw values
